styles.name: Cinematic Photo

signature.color_and_material: Deep green-black, off-white, muted captions and a restrained warm signal.
signature.composition: Broad photographic cover and dark breathing space; centred vertical scene filmstrip in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Large real photographic scenes interrupted by short reflections.
signature.imagery: Rights-documented local forest mist and sunset lake photographs, deliberately cropped.
signature.interaction: Local scene navigation, visible focus and native credit disclosure.
signature.motion: Static frames with short link transitions; no required video or parallax.
signature.navigation: Visible journal links and numbered local chapter anchors.
signature.typography: Quiet serif narrative headings and small neutral caption hierarchy.

styles.summary: Large photographic frames, dark breathing space and a slow scene sequence for visual storytelling.

styles.name: Editorial Journal

signature.color_and_material: Ivory paper, deep ink, muted olive and restrained editorial rules.
signature.composition: Literary masthead and unequal cover columns; narrow essay measure with a note margin.
signature.content_rhythm: Cover, departments and editor letter versus continuous argument and pull quotation.
signature.imagery: A static original CSS still-life, paired with a descriptive caption.
signature.interaction: Underlined local story links and native reading-note disclosure.
signature.motion: Short color transitions only; reading remains still.
signature.navigation: Publication departments in A; issue return and article contents in B.
signature.typography: Georgia serif headlines and reading text with quiet sans-serif metadata.

styles.summary: A literary issue cover and long-form essay, with serif reading rhythm, margin notes and quiet paper surfaces.

styles.name: Neo Brutalist

signature.color_and_material: Lemon field, violet signal, near-black thick borders and hard shadows.
signature.composition: Oversized poster words and offset stamp; thick framed programme in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Manifesto bands and exposed rows replace generic feature cards.
signature.imagery: Original CSS symbols and hard-edged type, without required photography.
signature.interaction: Pressed-state day filtering, local links and native access disclosure.
signature.motion: Short link changes; no flashing or running marquee.
signature.navigation: Blunt utility links and accessible day-selector buttons.
signature.typography: Heavy sans-serif with abrupt display/body scale contrast.

styles.summary: Loud poster language, exposed frames and hard shadows paired with a genuinely usable event programme.

styles.name: Swiss Grid

signature.color_and_material: Warm paper, near-black text, one red signal and hairline dividers.
signature.composition: Twelve-column alignment, oversized flush-left type and numbered horizontal divisions.
signature.content_rhythm: Long ruled service rows in A; staggered project fields and a colophon in B.
signature.imagery: Original CSS typographic studies instead of dependent photography.
signature.interaction: Underlined text links, offset focus rings and native details disclosures.
signature.motion: Only brief link-color changes; reduced motion removes transitions.
signature.navigation: A visible compact numbered index; no hidden mobile drawer.
signature.typography: One sans-serif family with abrupt scale changes and tight display tracking.

styles.summary: Numbered typographic grids, oversized alignment and precise service or portfolio indexes.
